model_bug_note: The user-flagged 'model bug' (R4 used L_total as denominator instead of L_event) was real in principle but numerically small. R4B's corrected formula with L_event per-swap gives correction factor 0.94-1.00 (median 0.9965). R4 was within 0.4% of the corrected answer on the median cell. The 81-cell matrix still shows positive net PnL for 78/81 cells. The recommendation is downgraded from R4's GO_TINY_LIVE_PLAN_ONLY to NEED_MORE_DATA per user policy, not because the math says so.
r4b_decision_basis: R4B's corrected active-liquidity formula produces results essentially identical to R4 (median correction factor 0.9965). The user-flagged bug was real in principle (R4 used L_total as denominator instead of L_event per-swap), but the numerical impact is small because L_event ≈ L_total for these pools. R4B's 81-cell matrix still shows positive net PnL for 78/81 cells. The recommendation is downgraded from R4's GO_TINY_LIVE_PLAN_ONLY to NEED_MORE_DATA per user policy on R4B (user explicitly disallowed GO at this stage and required verification). The math still supports positive net PnL; the downgrade is a process step.

R4B tightens the reasoning chain: use L_event per-swap, not L_total. The 81-cell matrix is re-validated. 78/81 cells are still GO. The user-flagged 'model bug' was real in principle but numerically small. The recommendation is NEED_MORE_DATA per user policy, not because the math says so.
